normalization: cross-sectional median / 1.4826 MAD within month x 2023 size quintile
baseline: difference in panel-median-centered log-YoY, robust monthly z, threshold=3
synthetic_type: persistent multiplicative level shift from onset through Dec-2024
event_recall_definition: events with correct-direction alarm within onset..onset+2 / all injected events
delay_definition: months from onset to first correct-direction alarm among detected events
false_alarm_definition: alarms in background months before any injected modification per 100 background series-months

secondary_month_level_definition.TP: correct-direction alarm in an active synthetic-event month
secondary_month_level_definition.FP: alarm in a background month or wrong-direction alarm in an active event month
secondary_month_level_definition.FN: active synthetic-event month without a correct-direction alarm

important_metric_note: Primary event Precision/F1 are intentionally omitted. Dividing first detected events by all monthly alarms mixes event-level and month-level units and penalizes repeated alarms from one persistent event.
note: Synthetic validation measures detection of controlled shifts. It is not ground truth for economic causality.
